description: This PHP class defines the Smarty_Internal_Method_SetDefaultModifiers, which provides a method to set default modifiers in a Smarty template system. It is part of the internal plugins of Smarty, allowing manipulation of template rendering behavior.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Method_SetDefaultModifiers
classes.description: A class providing a method to set default modifiers in Smarty templates.

methods.name: setDefaultModifiers
methods.description: Sets the default modifiers for a Smarty template object by assigning an array of modifiers to the smarty object's default_modifiers property.
